en.headline: Halloween installations light up Statue Square Gardens through 31 October
en.dek: The Central takeover features nightly illuminated displays from 4pm to 11:30pm, with special events on Chater Road on selected dates including Halloween night.
body: Halloween in Central continues through 31 October with illuminated installations at Statue Square Gardens South and activities along Chater Road.
Organisers said the installations run nightly from 4pm to 11:30pm, extending until 1am on 31 October. Special happenings on Chater Road take place on 17, 18, 24 and 31 October.
The event transforms parts of Central with themed displays, including large installations that have drawn visitors for photographs. Details of individual events are available from the organisers.

zh.headline: 萬聖狂歡祭中環裝置亮燈至10月31日
zh.dek: 皇后像廣場花園每晙4時至11時30分設有亮燈裝置，遮打道於包括萬聖節當晚在內的指定日子有特別活動。
body: 「萬聖狂歡祭・中環」活動持續至10月31日，皇后像廣場花園南設有亮燈裝置，遮打道亦有相關活動。
主辦單位表示，裝置每晚下午4時至晚上11時30分亮燈，10月31日延長至翌日凌晨1時。遮打道特別活動於10月17、18、24及31日舉行。
活動以萬聖節主題裝置改變中環部分地區面貌，包括大型裝置吸引訪客拍照。個別活動詳情可向主辦單位查詢。
